{{Quote|Ah, Berken's Flow...I learned how to mine there.|Surveyor [[Jo Keslev|Jo Kelsev]]|<ref name="SWG:TBFM" />}}
'''Berken's Flow''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Located east to the [[Burning Plains/Legends|Burning Plains]] and the [[Tulrus Nesting Grounds]], it had been built up over multiple generations of massive [[Magma/Legends|lava]] flows.<ref name="SWG:EoM">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Exploration of Mustafar|Mustafar}}</ref> The region was named after the [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] [[Jesl Berken]]<ref name="SWG:TBFM" /> who discovered rich mineral deposits located in this dangerous area<ref name="SWG:EoM" /> long before the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:BF" /> The establishment of Mustafar as a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world and the wealth of the planet started with the discovery of Berken's Flow<ref name="SWG:TBFM" /> as the region was for some times the richest source of natural resources in the galaxy.<ref name="SWG:BF" /> However, years of over mining and major planetary shifts had left the region limited in resources.<ref name="SWG:BF" /> With most of its minerals extracted, only small mining operations took place in Berken's Flow during the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="SWG:TBFM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Berken's Flow appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Berken's Flow was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:BF" />
